kicker: The Fan Vote · Wk of Aug 26–Sep 1

slides.h: Forget who's [[#1]]. Look at who's moving.
slides.dek: We pulled this week's fan episode rankings against last week's and did our own math. Six shows climbing fast, one big faller.

slides.title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman
slides.why: Last week #38. This week #11. The single biggest climb on the whole chart.

slides.title: One Piece
slides.why: Last week #29. This week #5. A 900-plus episode show still capable of a week like this.

slides.title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked
slides.why: Last week #28. This week #10. Quietly one of the season's steadiest risers.

slides.title: Skeleton Knight in Another World
slides.why: Last week #40. This week #29. Almost off the chart, now solidly on it.

slides.title: The Cat and the Dragon
slides.why: Last week #19. This week #9. First time inside the top 10 this season.

slides.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
slides.why: Last week #17. This week #8. Word of mouth is doing real work here.

slides.body: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime slid from #10 to #22 this week, the chart's biggest drop. Save this for your watchlist and tell us who you think keeps climbing.
